title: Fridge Magnets

outline.arc: Little starts with a magnet on the fridge, compares what sticks and slides, notices a pull across a gap, tries turning two magnets, and records a question to test again.

beatIntents.intent: A warm kitchen scene, Big and Little Wonderer looking closely at a large round ochre fridge magnet on a sage steel fridge door. Big holds a brass magnifier near the magnet; Little looks toward it. Notebook on a wood counter, soft lamp light. The round magnet is the clear central subject.

Closer view beside the same sage steel fridge door. A large ochre round magnet holds one corner of a cream paper drawing against the door. Little has just let go; both hands are away. Big stands close beside Little and both look at the magnet holding the paper. Calm kitchen light.

A kitchen tabletop experiment on a shallow wooden tray. Big holds a plain wood test board upright; an ochre round magnet has slid down and now rests at the bottom of the board on the tray. Little looks at it, beside a plastic lid, paper scrap, folded cloth and aluminum foil. A steel paperclip waits separately. Quiet evidence, not falling action.

A very close tabletop scene: Big holds a large round ochre magnet just above and to the left of a steel paperclip, which tilts toward the magnet across a very short visible air gap. Little watches beside Big. A wooden ruler lies flat alongside on the tray. Physically coherent, slight lift, no magical rays, soft lamp light.

Big and Little compare two large simple bar magnets on the kitchen table. Big holds one bar magnet horizontally at each end, hands away from the tiny gap between their facing ends. Little watches from beside Big. One muted ochre magnet and one warm dark slate magnet. Both magnets are far from faces. Quiet shared curiosity, no arrows, text or sparks.

An open notebook with a simple drawing of a magnet and a steel paperclip with a small gap. Little draws with a pencil while Big looks beside Little. Large ochre fridge magnet, ruler and paperclip rest neatly on the tray, sage fridge in soft background. Notebook has only the small drawing, no text. A warm pool of lamplight closes the day.

apparatus: Code-drawn SVG; no separate raster apparatus.
